mandatory_results.description: Entities not eligible to make an IPO
mandatory_results.required_value: None of the Reg 5(1)(a)-(d) or Reg 5(2) disqualifications applies
mandatory_results.explanation: All Reg 5 conditions are evidenced as not applying.
mandatory_results.rule_name: Entities not eligible to make an IPO
limitations: Debarment that has expired before DRHP filing is excluded by the Explanation to Reg 5(1); the engine relies on the declaration reflecting this.
Reg 5(2) exemptions (ESOPs, fully exercised SARs, and convertibles required to convert before RHP filing) must be applied when preparing the declaration.

mandatory_results.regulation_reference: SEBI (ICDR) Regulations, 2018, Regulation 6(1)(a); definition in Regulation 2(1)(gg)
mandatory_results.description: Net tangible assets of at least ₹3 crore
mandatory_results.required_value: ≥ ₹3.00 Cr NTA in each of the 3 preceding full years
mandatory_results.explanation: NTA was at least ₹3.00 Cr in each of FY2022, FY2023, FY2024.
mandatory_results.rule_name: Net tangible assets of at least ₹3 crore
limitations: Requires restated and consolidated figures; the engine cannot verify the basis of manually entered values.

mandatory_results.regulation_reference: SEBI (ICDR) Regulations, 2018, Regulation 6(1)(a) and its two provisos
mandatory_results.description: Monetary assets not more than 50% of net tangible assets
mandatory_results.required_value: Monetary assets ≤ 50.00% of NTA in each preceding full year (unless excess is committed, or the IPO is entirely an OFS)
mandatory_results.explanation: Monetary assets were within 50% of NTA in each preceding full year.
mandatory_results.rule_name: Monetary assets not more than 50% of net tangible assets
limitations: 'Monetary assets' is not defined in Reg 2; the engine relies on the issuer's classification.

mandatory_results.description: Average operating profit of at least ₹15 crore with profit in each year
mandatory_results.required_value: Average operating profit ≥ ₹15.00 Cr over the preceding 3 years, with operating profit in each year
mandatory_results.explanation: Average operating profit ₹20.00 Cr meets ₹15.00 Cr, with operating profit in each year.
mandatory_results.rule_name: Average operating profit of at least ₹15 crore with profit in each year
limitations: 'Operating profit' is not defined in Reg 2; profit before tax, EBIT or EBITDA must not be substituted without professional judgement.
Changed in 2.0.0: v1 used the best 3 of 5 years (ICDR 2009 test).

mandatory_results.regulation_reference: SEBI (ICDR) Regulations, 2018, Regulation 6(1)(c); definition in Regulation 2(1)(hh)
mandatory_results.description: Net worth of at least ₹1 crore
mandatory_results.required_value: ≥ ₹1.00 Cr net worth in each of the 3 preceding full years
mandatory_results.explanation: Net worth was at least ₹1.00 Cr in each preceding full year.
mandatory_results.rule_name: Net worth of at least ₹1 crore

mandatory_results.description: Revenue from new-name activity after a recent name change
mandatory_results.required_value: If the name changed within the last year, ≥ 50.00% of the preceding full year's revenue from the new-name activity
mandatory_results.explanation: The issuer has not changed its name within the last one year.
mandatory_results.rule_name: Revenue from new-name activity after a recent name change

mandatory_results.description: Alternative eligibility route: book building with ≥75% of net offer to QIBs
mandatory_results.required_value: Book-built issue; undertaking to allot ≥ 75.00% of the net offer to QIBs and to refund the full subscription if it fails to do so
mandatory_results.explanation: Not applicable to the declared listing route 'mainboard_reg6_1'. Applicability: Only when the case declares the Reg 6(2) route. NOT_APPLICABLE for Reg 6(1).
mandatory_results.rule_name: Alternative eligibility route: book building with ≥75% of net offer to QIBs

mandatory_results.description: Minimum promoters' contribution of 20% of post-issue capital
mandatory_results.required_value: Promoters hold ≥ 20.00% of post-issue capital (shortfall up to 10.00% may be met by eligible investors)
mandatory_results.rule_name: Minimum promoters' contribution of 20% of post-issue capital
limitations: Reg 14(2) form-of-contribution and Reg 15 eligibility-of-securities conditions are not evaluated.

mandatory_results.regulation_reference: SEBI (ICDR) Regulations, 2018, Regulation 16(1)(a) and proviso (as amended w.e.f. 13-08-2021)
mandatory_results.required_value: Minimum promoters' contribution locked in for 18 months (36 months if the majority of fresh-issue proceeds is for capital expenditure)
mandatory_results.explanation: Committed lock-in of 18 months meets the 18-month requirement.
calculation: Required 18 months (capex issue: False); committed 18 months
limitations: Lock-in of promoter holding in excess of the minimum contribution (Reg 16(1)(b): 6 months / 1 year) is not evaluated.

mandatory_results.regulation_reference: Securities Contracts (Regulation) Rules, 1957, Rule 19(2)(b) as substituted by G.S.R. 184(E), 13-03-2026
mandatory_results.required_value: Minimum public offer per the applicable SCRR Rule 19(2)(b) tier (post-issue capital at offer price)
mandatory_results.explanation: The proposed public offer meets the tier 1 minimum (offer ≥ 25.00%).
calculation: Tier 1: post-issue capital at offer price ₹800.00 Cr
limitations: Primary gazette text not retrieved; tier content corroborated by two secondary sources only.
Tier 6 contains both a 1% and a 2.5% condition in secondary summaries; an offer between them is sent for human review rather than failed.
Post-listing minimum public shareholding timelines are not evaluated.
Changed in 2.0.0: v1 used a two-tier 25% / 10% split at Rs 1,600 crore.

mandatory_results.regulation_reference: Stock exchange main-board listing criteria, BSE / NSE main-board eligibility criteria (see also ICDR Reg 229 for the SME route)
mandatory_results.description: Minimum post-issue paid-up capital of ₹10 crore (exchange criterion)
mandatory_results.explanation: Post-issue paid-up capital of ₹15.00 Cr meets the exchange minimum of ₹10.00 Cr.
mandatory_results.rule_name: Minimum post-issue paid-up capital of ₹10 crore (exchange criterion)
limitations: Exchange page not retrievable; threshold unverified.
Issuers with post-issue paid-up capital up to Rs 10 crore are eligible for the SME route under ICDR Reg 229(1).

mandatory_results.regulation_reference: Stock exchange main-board listing criteria, BSE main-board eligibility criteria
mandatory_results.description: Minimum market capitalisation of ₹25 crore (exchange criterion)
mandatory_results.required_value: Market capitalisation at issue price ≥ ₹25.00 Cr
mandatory_results.explanation: Market capitalisation at issue price of ₹800.00 Cr meets the exchange minimum of ₹25.00 Cr.
mandatory_results.rule_name: Minimum market capitalisation of ₹25 crore (exchange criterion)
limitations: Exchange page not retrievable; threshold unverified.

mandatory_results.regulation_reference: Stock exchange main-board listing criteria, BSE main-board eligibility criteria
mandatory_results.description: Minimum issue size of ₹10 crore (exchange criterion)
mandatory_results.explanation: Issue size of ₹100.00 Cr meets the exchange minimum of ₹10.00 Cr.
mandatory_results.rule_name: Minimum issue size of ₹10 crore (exchange criterion)
limitations: Exchange page not retrievable; threshold unverified.
Replaces v1 rule ISSUE_SIZE_5X (issue size <= 5x pre-issue net worth), which is an ICDR 2009 condition not found in ICDR 2018.

advisory_results.regulation_reference: Stock exchange main-board listing criteria, NSE main-board eligibility criteria (unverified)
advisory_results.explanation: The company has 5 years of operation.
limitations: Exchange criteria not retrievable; reclassified from mandatory to advisory in 2.0.0. ICDR Reg 6(1) already requires three full years of financial history.

advisory_results.required_value: ≥ 1/3 independent directors if the chair is non-executive and not a promoter; otherwise ≥ 1/2
advisory_results.explanation: 3 of 6 independent; meets the 1/3 requirement under LODR Reg 17(1)(b).
calculation: 3/6 independent vs required 1/3 (chair executive: False, chair promoter: False)
limitations: 'Related to any promoter' is approximated by the is_chair_promoter flag.
Reg 17(1)(a) (woman director, 50% non-executive) is not evaluated.

advisory_results.explanation: Audit committee composition meets LODR Reg 18(1)(a), (b) and (d).
limitations: Financial literacy / expertise (Reg 18(1)(c)) is not evaluated.

advisory_results.regulation_reference: Engineering heuristic (context: LODR Reg 23), Heuristic — no regulatory threshold
advisory_results.required_value: Related party transactions certified at arm's length
advisory_results.explanation: Related party transactions are certified at arm's length.
limitations: The 20% ratio is an engineering heuristic, not the LODR materiality threshold.

advisory_results.regulation_reference: Engineering heuristic (context: Companies Act, 2013 s.143), Heuristic
advisory_results.description: Auditor qualifications or modified opinion (diligence indicator)
advisory_results.required_value: No qualifications and an unmodified audit opinion
advisory_results.actual_value: Deloitte Haskins & Sells LLP: unmodified, no qualifications
advisory_results.explanation: No auditor qualification or modified opinion is evidenced.
advisory_results.rule_name: Auditor qualifications or modified opinion (diligence indicator)

advisory_results.regulation_reference: Engineering heuristic (context: ICDR Schedule VI disclosure), Heuristic — no regulatory threshold
advisory_results.required_value: No pending criminal cases; total exposure ≤ 20% of latest net worth (heuristic)
limitations: Materiality under ICDR is determined by the issuer's board-approved policy; the 20% ratio is a heuristic.

observations: No failure was identified among the supported mandatory screening checks on the evidence provided. This is not a legal determination of IPO eligibility.

ruleset_version.description: Main-board IPO screening subset re-based on the SEBI ICDR 2018 consolidated text (last amended 21-03-2026), LODR 2015 (last amended 14-07-2026) and SCRR Rule 19(2)(b) as substituted on 13-03-2026. Not legally reviewed.
regulations: Engineering heuristic (context: ICDR Schedule VI disclosure)

unresolved_issues: Mandatory rules whose legal source is not verified against a primary text: EXCHANGE_MIN_ISSUE_SIZE, MIN_MARKET_CAP, MIN_POST_ISSUE_CAPITAL, PUBLIC_OFFER_MIN
limitations: This is a decision-support screening against an explicitly limited set of rules; it is not a legal opinion and not a determination of IPO eligibility or approval.
The ruleset has not been reviewed by a qualified securities-law professional (REGULATORY_VALIDATION_CONFIRMED is false unless stated otherwise).
Extracted facts can contain errors; values flagged for review must be verified against the source documents.
A 'no failure identified' outcome means no supported mandatory check failed on the evidence provided. Unsupported provisions are not evaluated.
